sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive recent run of form (W-D-W-W-W), host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This should be a comfortable matchup on paper—Alsager sit bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 games and are in terrible form with five consecutive losses before a lone win. Sandbach will be looking to extend their lead at the summit and maintain their unbeaten streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match with title-race implications, as Stafford sit just two points behind the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) host Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct top-six clash, with Bridgnorth's recent loss to Eccleshall still fresh. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in a mid-table fixture. Barnton, unbeaten in their last game, host Shawbury United, who are struggling badly on a five-game losing streak. Market Drayton Town face New Mills, with both sides having inconsistent records. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a clash between two lower-table sides. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, the league's bottom dwellers who have won just once all season. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's most troubled teams, with Telford picking up only one win from nine games.
